claim: Deterministic empty/minimal-KB synthetic cases provide complete requirement ground truth and measure P11 plus P13 false-completeness reduction offline.
invariants: Ground truth includes every applicable and not-applicable requirement for every case.
P11 reports recall, precision, critical requirement misses and finite requirement states.
Missing, bad-source, applicability, conflicting and unknown-semantic evidence never reaches SUFFICIENT.
INTERNET_RESULT and MODEL_RESULT are never accepted as Knowledge or Authority; only ACTIVE_CURATED_KNOWLEDGE can satisfy a requirement.
The combined Sufficiency result is compared with the frozen CKS-07 simple solver on identical case bytes.
The artifact is offline, synthetic, read-only knowledge evidence and grants no credential, policy, capability, tool-write or execution authority.
